prompts.label: Softform — CYCLING
prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE highly polished web experience screen for a 2026 annual Garmin-data recap by mini. The attached image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY; create the specified new scene. Preserve its exceptional material rendering and spacious art direction. Athletic editorial typography, big accurate numbers, a clear sports and wellbeing identity. One iconic sculpture, restrained composition, generous whitespace. All data fictional. No collage, busy environment, browser/device frames, dashboards, photos, tiny decorative shapes, invented statistics, graphs or additional copy. Render requested wording accurately. For chapter screens use a LANDSCAPE 16:10 viewport with small "mini." upper left, "YOUR 2026" upper right, chapter label above the headline, hero metric and brief secondary stats left, sculpture on right; thin four-segment progress indicator at bottom with appropriate segment active and a minimal "Continue →" control. Bottom corner tiny "CONCEPT / FICTIONAL DATA". Keep readable text well clear of sculpture. SOFTFORM system: tactile matte silicone, slightly soft but adult and sporty, sculptural chunky geometric shapes, vermilion red / cornflower blue / buttery yellow, substantial soft shadows, seamless studio cyclorama. Strong tightly composed sans typography like a high-end sports campaign, not a children's toy website. Never chrome or glass.CYCLING CHAPTER, landscape. Exact chapter "01 / CYCLING". Heading "You went\nthe distance." Hero number "8,642" with clear unit "KM CYCLED". Secondary stat line "126 rides · 412 hours". It must immediately feel like cycling performance and momentum. Pale warm lilac backdrop. Sculpture: one large vermilion torus-like wheel tilted forward in a dynamic three-quarter pose, with a cornflower blue sphere nested as a hub and a low buttery-yellow curved ramp under the wheel. Only these three solid shapes, no spokes or realistic bicycle. Energetic, sculptural and unmistakably wheel-inspired. Compose metric and wheel boldly.
